summary: Iteration 4 frontend-only verification of Pro Photo Sorter. Runtime Playwright testing on the public preview URL (app loads clean with 0 console/page errors, Batch toggle turns green, batch-auto-enhance correctly hidden with 0 selections, Help modal opens and closes with Escape, Settings Cancel bugfix still holds — template reverts to Default on reopen) plus static source verification of all new iteration-4 testids/functions (ImageEditor angle grid + auto-tone + aspect ratios + Looks, App.batchAutoEnhance, lib/autoTone.js exports, storage DEFAULT_STATE.looks). No File System Access flows were executed (cannot be automated).
critical_code_review_comments: usePersistedState only writes localStorage on the first mutation, so pps.state.v2 is absent (NULL) until the user changes something. The 'looks' key appears correctly once any persist runs (verified keys: categories, settings, ratings, looks; looks=[]). Not a bug, but if a spec requires the key to exist on first load, add an initial saveState on mount.
App.js (987 lines) and ImageEditor.jsx (913 lines) exceed the 700-line guideline; consider splitting ImageEditor panels (Looks, Crop, Tone) and App toolbar/batch logic into modules.

batchAutoEnhance re-decodes and re-encodes full-resolution images sequentially in the main thread; large batches will block the UI. Consider yielding between items or using createImageBitmap + OffscreenCanvas.
seed_data_creation: None. Temporary localStorage writes made during testing were cleared at the end.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified static presence of testids: toggle-angle-grid, auto-tone, aspect-Free/1x1/4x3/3x2/16x9 (generated from ASPECT_RATIOS labels via label.replace(':','x')), save-look-btn, look-name-input, look-save-confirm, look-<id>, delete-look-<id>. angle-slider has onPointerDown/Up/Cancel + onFocus/onBlur setting angleGrid, and a manual toggle button. App.js line 409 defines batchAutoEnhance; batch-auto-enhance button guarded by `batchMode && batchSelected.size > 0`. lib/autoTone.js exports autoAnalyze (line 4) and autoAnalyzeFile (line 52). Editor canvas / crop drag / batch enhance cannot be exercised without a real image via the directory picker (not automatable). Escape closes Help and Settings modals.
rca_of_the_issue: The only anomaly (pps.state.v2 NULL right after a fresh load/refresh) is by design: persist() writes localStorage only inside mutation setters, so a clean profile has no stored state until the first change. After saving Settings and refreshing, the JSON contained the expected 'looks': [] key.
